agents.role: Runs the composition loop: renders one take per seed from a genre brief, measures it, and appends it to the take log.
Applies the keeper rules as code to every take: a take passes or fails measurably, and the verdict and reason are recorded.
Exports keepers as the catalogue with a licence and provenance line per track, and refuses any track whose rights line is empty.

alerts.carries: Take id, session id, and the keeper-rule reason it failed. Reasons only, no audio.
Session id, keeper count, and catalogue titles. Counts and titles only.
Session id and how long the loop has produced no new take. State only.

sends.carries: Session id, keeper count, and catalogue titles. Counts and titles only.

firstboot.label: Directory where sessions, take logs, and keeper audio live
Default genre brief id (chipsynth, ambient, or boom-bap)

summary: The studio that never closes: a composition loop that renders real audio takes from genre briefs, logs every attempt, applies a measurable curation bar, and exports keepers as a licensed catalogue. SPEC ONLY at HN-026: this is a pack definition, not a running studio. The runtime lands in the later HN tasks of this lane.

urgency.meaning: Never used by this pack: no studio event is life-safety.
A session stalled mid-run with takes unlogged.
Take rejections and keeper verdicts during a session.

watchers.watches: The take log: every composition attempt recorded with prompt, seed and parameters, duration, verdict, and reason, in order, so no take is ever lost or invented after the fact.

inputs: Measured loudness, silence ratio, and repetition for each take
watchers.watches: The curation bar: length, loudness, silence ratio, and repetition measured per take, so a take passes or fails measurably and the reason is on the record.

inputs: Keeper verdicts from the keeper gate
watchers.watches: The catalogue: keepers exported with a licence and provenance line per track, refusing any track whose rights line is empty.
